Suárez’s son, Benjamín, stood nearby and watched as the families enjoyed the lighthearted exchange. The friendship between the Messi and Suárez families goes far beyond the soccer pitch. Their children have also grown close over the years, with the families frequently spending time together and even vacationing as a group.

articles.title: Haaland shows off star studded World Cup jersey collection
articles.summary: Erling Haaland may be one of the biggest stars in world football, but the Manchester City striker still gets excited about collecting jerseys from other elite players. After the 2026 FIFA World Cup, Haaland showed off an impressive collection of shirts he received from some of the tournament’s biggest names and his close friends, including Neymar, Kylian Mbappé, Jude Bellingham, Harry Kane and Achraf Hakimi. Despite being a superstar himself, Haaland appeared proud to have jerseys from players he admires and shares a strong relationship with. The Norwegian revealed that he plans to keep the collection somewhere safe, and it is easy to see why. With so many iconic names already part of it, Haaland could continue adding to the collection before eventually putting the jerseys on display once his playing career is over.
